{{c|''The Chri{{ls}}tian Ievves reprehend the fore{{ls}}aid fact of Peter in baptizing the Gentils 4 But he alleaging his fore{{ls}}aid vvarrants, and {{ls}}hevving plainly that it vvas of God, 18 they like good Catholikes do yeld. 19 By the fore{{ls}}aid per{{ls}}ecution, the Church is yet further dilated, not only into al Ievvrie, Galilee, and Samaria, but al{{ls}}o into other Countries: {{ls}}pecially in Antiochia Syriæ the increa{{ls}}e among the Greekes, is notable, fir{{ls}}t by the fore{{ls}}aid di{{ls}}per{{ls}}ed, 22 then by Barnabas, thirdly by him and Saul together: {{ls}}o that there beginneth the name of Chri{{ls}}tians: 27 vvith perfite vnity betvvene them and the Church that vvas before them at Hieru{{ls}}alem.''}}
